svg.aria-label: The GPU of the Jetson Orin NX drawn from the output of gpu_info: eight streaming multiprocessors, each with 128 CUDA cores, room for 1,536 resident threads, 65,536 registers and 164 KiB of shared memory and L1 cache. All eight share a 2,048 KiB L2 cache. Device memory is the board's 15.3 GiB of LPDDR5, which the CPU also uses. Two copy engines move data while kernels run.
svg.text: What one nvidia.com/gpu unit contains on our cluster
Eight streaming multiprocessors, one L2 cache, and memory that the CPU uses too.
THE ORIN'S GPU, AS GPU_INFO REPORTS IT
L2 cache, 2,048 KiB, shared by all eight SMs
device memory: the board's 15.3 GiB of LPDDR5, shared with the CPU
